sql.blueravenCustomFieldGroup.getAssignments: select cfg.id, cfg.group_name as "groupName", cfg.group_order as "groupOrder", coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(fields))) FROM ( select ccv.id, ccv.source_id as "sourceId", false as "valueWasChanged", ccv.date_value as "dateValue", ccv.timestamp_value as "timestampValue", ccv.boolean_value as "booleanValue", ccv.text_value as "textValue", ccv.numeric_value as "numericValue", ccv.int_value as "intValue", ccv.int_array_value as "intArrayValue", cfga.custom_field_group_id as "customFieldGroupId", cfga.id as "customFieldGroupAssignmentId", cfga.custom_field_id as "customFieldId", cfga.field_order as "fieldOrder", cf.list_of_value_id as "listOfValueId", cf.field_name as "fieldName", cf.company_data_type_id as "companyDataTypeId", cfg.object_type_id as "objectTypeId", cdt.data_type_id as "dataTypeId", cdt.has_list_values as "hasListValues", coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(listOfValues))) FROM ( select lov.id, lov.name, lov.code, lov.parent_id as "parentId", lov.show_other as "showOther", lov.display_order as "displayOrder" from brs.list_of_value lov where lov.parent_id is not null and lov.parent_id = cf.list_of_value_id and lov.archived is not true order by lov.display_order ) listOfValues), '[]') AS "listOfValues" from brs.custom_field_group_assignment cfga inner join brs.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfga.custom_field_id inner join flow.company_data_type cdt on cdt.id = cf.company_data_type_id left join brs.custom_field_value ccv on ccv.custom_field_group_assignment_id = cfga.id and ccv.source_id = :sourceId where cfga.custom_field_group_id = cfg.id and cfga.archived is not true and cf.archived is not true order by cfga.field_order, cf.field_name ) fields), '[]') AS "customFieldValues" from brs.custom_field_group cfg inner join brs.object_type cot on cot.id = cfg.object_type_id where cot.id = :objectTypeId and cfg.archived is not true order by cfg.group_order
sql.blueravenCustomFieldGroup.assignment.get: select cfg.*, cfg.group_name as original_group_name, cot.object_type, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(customFields))) FROM ( SELECT cfga.id, cfga.custom_field_group_id as "customFieldGroupId", cfga.custom_field_id as "customFieldId", cfga.id as "customFieldGroupAssignmentId", cfga.field_order as "fieldOrder", cfga.archived, cf.field_name as "fieldName", cfot.id as "customFieldObjectTypeId", null as "processStepName", null as "groupName" FROM brs.custom_field_group_assignment cfga inner join brs.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfga.custom_field_id inner join brs.custom_field_object_type cfot on cfot.custom_field_id = cf.id WHERE cfga.custom_field_group_id = cfg.id AND cfga.archived is not true AND cfot.archived is not true and cfot.object_type_id = :objectTypeId ORDER BY "fieldOrder", "fieldName") customFields), '[]') AS "customFields" from brs.custom_field_group cfg inner join brs.object_type cot on cot.id = cfg.object_type_id where cot.id = :objectTypeId and cfg.archived is not true order by cfg.group_order, cfg.group_name
sql.blueravenCustomFieldGroup.findBySourceId: select id from brs.custom_field_value where source_id = :sourceId and custom_field_group_assignment_id = :customFieldGroupAssignmentId
sql.blueravenCustomFieldGroup.insertCustomFi: insert into brs.custom_field_group(group_name, object_type_id, group_order, created_by_id) values (:groupName, :objectTypeId, (select coalesce(max(group_order) + 1, 0) from brs.custom_field_group where object_type_id = :objectTypeId), :createdById)
sql.blueravenCustomFieldGroup.updateCustomFi: update brs.custom_field_group set group_name = :groupName, group_order = :groupOrder, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.blueravenCustomFieldGroup.assignment.get: select cfg.*, ot.object_type, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(customFields))) FROM ( SELECT cfga.id, cfga.custom_field_group_id as "customFieldGroupId", cfga.custom_field_id as "customFieldId", cfga.field_order as "fieldOrder", cfga.archived, cf.field_name as "fieldName", cfot.id as "customFieldObjectTypeId" FROM brs.custom_field_group_assignment cfga inner join brs.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfga.custom_field_id inner join brs.custom_field_object_type cfot on cfot.custom_field_id = cf.id WHERE cfga.custom_field_group_id = cfg.id AND cfga.archived is not true) customFields), '[]') AS "customFields" from brs.custom_field_group cfg inner join brs.object_type ot on ot.id = cfg.object_type_id where cfg.id = :id
sql.blueravenCustomFieldGroup.updateCustomFi: update brs.custom_field_value set date_value = :dateValue::date, timestamp_value = :timestampValue::timestamp, boolean_value = :booleanValue, text_value = :textValue, numeric_value = :numericValue, int_value = :intValue, int_array_value = :intArrayValue, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.blueravenCustomFieldGroup.bulkUpdateCust: update brs.custom_field_value set date_value = :dateValue::date, timestamp_value = :timestampValue::timestamp, boolean_value = :booleanValue, text_value = :textValue, numeric_value = :numericValue, int_value = :intValue, int_array_value = :intArrayValue, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id in (:cfvIds)
sql.blueravenCustomFieldGroup.insertCustomFi: insert into brs.custom_field_value(source_id, date_value, custom_field_group_assignment_id, timestamp_value, boolean_value, text_value, numeric_value, int_value, int_array_value, created_by_id) values (:sourceId, :dateValue::date, :customFieldGroupAssignmentId, :timestampValue::timestamp, :booleanValue, :textValue, :numericValue, :intValue, :intArrayValue, :createdById)
sql.blueravenCustomFieldGroup.assignment.del: update brs.custom_field_group_assignment set archived = true, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :modifiedById where id = :id
sql.blueravenCustomFieldGroup.deleteCustomFi: update brs.custom_field_group set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.blueravenCustomFieldGroup.assignment.get: select cf.id,cf.field_name, cfot.object_type_id from brs.custom_field_object_type cfot inner join brs.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfot.custom_field_id inner join brs.object_type cot on cot.id = cfot.object_type_id where cot.id = :companyObjectTypeId and cfot.archived is not true and cf.archived is not true except select cf.id,cf.field_name, cfg.object_type_id from brs.custom_field_group_assignment cfga inner join brs.custom_field_group cfg on cfg.id = cfga.custom_field_group_id inner join brs.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfga.custom_field_id inner join brs.object_type cot on cot.id = cfg.object_type_id where cot.id = :companyObjectTypeId and cfga.archived is not true and cf.archived is not true and cfg.archived is not true order by field_name

SELECT cfga.id, cfga.id as custom_field_group_assignment_id, cfga.custom_field_group_id as "customFieldGroupId", cfga.custom_field_id as "customFieldId", cfga.field_order as "fieldOrder", cfga.archived, cf.field_name, cfg.group_name, cot.object_type as "objectType" FROM brs.custom_field_group_assignment cfga inner join brs.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfga.custom_field_id inner join brs.custom_field_group cfg on cfg.id = cfga.custom_field_group_id inner join brs.object_type cot on cot.id = cfg.object_type_id WHERE cfga.id = :id
sql.blueravenCustomFieldGroup.assignment.add: insert into brs.custom_field_group_assignment(custom_field_group_id, custom_field_id, field_order, created_by_id) values (:customFieldGroupId, :customFieldId, (select coalesce(max(field_order) + 1, 0) from brs.custom_field_group_assignment where custom_field_group_id = :customFieldGroupId and archived is not true), :createdById)
sql.blueravenCustomFieldGroup.assignment.upd: update brs.custom_field_group_assignment set field_order = :fieldOrder, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :modifiedById where id = :id
